name: zmcp
description: Brain location and caller-directed initialization guidance.

interface.longDescription: Provides Brain location and initialization links during MCP connection initialization. The startup tool directs the caller to current Brain routing and No role by default; it does not read Drive or assign a role. A legacy ground tool returns local fixture data only, not live Brain grounding. Requires local execution and Python.
interface.defaultPrompt: What is Brain and where is its initialization document?
